name: Default
shortDescription: Web app that converts e-books into chaptered audiobooks with dozens of TTS engines, optional voice cloning and over 1600 languages, running on CPU.

alerts.message: The web interface has no login: anyone who knows the URL can use it and download the generated audiobooks. Restrict access if the instance is public.

This variant runs on CPU only. Modern TTS engines such as XTTSv2 are very slow without a GPU; lighter engines such as YourTTS or Tacotron2 convert faster. Plan for at least 2 GB of RAM (8 GB recommended) and several GB of disk for downloaded models.
